items.title: Cal Collins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 11, 1997
items.q: Well I’ll tell you there’s some things he did that I liked.

ctx.x: Okay, how about, let’s see — Chuck Berry?

Well I’ll tell you there’s some things he did that I liked. I never was a fan — I was more of a fan of his then oh the other guy that everybody went crazy about, the guitar player that played with his teeth and everything?
